caption: The drawing depicts two views of an ornate dress, shown in both front and back perspectives. The dress is rendered in shades of gray with delicate, intricate detailing. The front view is more prominently colored and features long, puffed sleeves with floral embroidery and lace-like trim at the cuffs, a high neckline with further floral decoration, a fitted bodice with vertical decorative elements, and a wide, cinched waistband. The skirt is full-length with additional floral embroidery scattered throughout, especially along the hemline, and the edge of the skirt has a softly scalloped appearance. The back view, illustrated in lighter, sketch-like lines without full coloring, mirrors the sleeve, waistband, and hem details of the front, and shows a large bow tied at the waist, extending down the back, along with matching embroidery. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Dress
